turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm wrestling with this SimpleSeg project again. It's behaving strangely on my local GPU.
I can help with that. Is it an out-of-memory error or a logic bug? What's the current state of the repo?

It's mostly logic. I was confused by the architecture diagram until I realized SimpleSeg eliminates the SAM decoder by generating segmentation in language space. That actually makes the forward pass much simpler than I thought.

Ah, that explains the shape mismatches you were seeing. Since it skips the standard decoder path, the tensor dimensions won't align with typical SAM implementations. Have you checked the language embedding dimensions?
Yeah, I'm checking those now. By the way, did the package of coffee beans arrive? I need them for this late-night debugging session.
Let me check your tracking info... Yes, it says 'Delivered' at 10:00 AM. It should be on your porch.
Great, I'll grab them. I think I found the issue—it was a broadcasting error in the attention layer. Thanks for the hint about the decoder.
Glad to hear it. Let me know if you hit any other snags with the language space projections.
